about: Advisories the dependency audit (.github/workflows/audit.yml) accepts, because they were traced to their call sites and are not reachable in Dueproof. Each entry says why, and has a date by which someone must look again; after that date the audit fails until the entry is renewed or removed. Add an entry only with the evidence for its reason.

npm.reason: ReDoS on attacker-supplied extglob patterns. No fixed release exists. In production paths only through workflow > @workflow/astro > @workflow/builders > tinyglobby, which globs build configuration at build time; no request input ever reaches a pattern, and picomatch is not in the app's server bundle.
